summary: Backend end-to-end testing complete. 26/26 pytest tests passed covering auth (phone+password), categories, tasks CRUD, applications flow, accept-and-chat auto-creation, messaging polling, profile updates, specialist profile, and role-based authorization. Tested via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://task-connect-89.preview.emergentagent.com/api).

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary dict body (no Pydantic model). Works but lacks schema validation; unknown fields silently ignored which is fine, but a typed model would be safer.

allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is a known FastAPI/Starlette anti-pattern (browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard). Currently no breakage because frontend uses Bearer tokens, not cookies, but should be tightened.
Idempotency: re-accepting the same already-accepted application silently re-runs updates. Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 600 lines in a single file — consider splitting into routers (auth, tasks, applications, chats) for maintainability as features grow.

CORS: with allow_credentials=True, allow_origins='*' should be replaced by an explicit list (e.g., FRONTEND_URL) or rely on allow_origin_regex only — current setup may break cookie-based auth in browsers.
PATCH /auth/profile uses untyped dict body — use a Pydantic ProfileUpdate model for validation and OpenAPI docs.
accept_application: no idempotency guard (already-accepted re-trigger updates again). Add a status check before re-processing.
task_to_public performs N+1 count_documents per task in list endpoints — for scale, use an aggregation $lookup or store applications_count denormalized on the task.
phone normalization strips non-digits but allows arbitrarily short strings (no minimum length / E.164 validation).
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook recommends 5-fail lockout).
JWT uses 7-day access tokens with no refresh-token rotation — acceptable for MVP but document it.
test_credentials: Dynamically generated per run (phone like +373<timestamp>, password pass1234). No seeded admin needed. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present — flagged.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates 3 fresh users (1 customer, 2 specialists, +1 ad-hoc specialist) and 2 tasks. Data is not cleaned up afterwards; consider a teardown fixture if running repeatedly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 requested backend endpoints verified end-to-end through public URL. Auth uses phone (normalized) + password + JWT bearer. Chat is auto-created on accept_application. /api/auth/profile takes plain dict. bcrypt hashes generated with $2b$. No frontend testing performed per request.
